answer: Deposits are visible in relic, and summit reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 92 aliases, and each one needs its own funded beacon account. A bond of 49% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Each duplicate costs another 135 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
